content.query:
STEPS:

--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
select CustomerAccountId,CustomerId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode,count(1)
from bnkm.customeraccount group by CustomerAccountId,CustomerId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode
having count(1) > 1



--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE   with pipeline alternative
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY  CustomerAccountId,CustomerId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode ORDER BY CustomerAccountId DESC, INSERTDTTM DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* INTO bnkm.customeraccount_WITH_DUP_20230801 --Name of backup table to store duplicate records
FROM bnkm.customeraccount;



--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN AND BU TABLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.customeraccount_WITH_DUP_20230801
--5938032

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.customeraccount
--5938032


--4 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE bnkm.customeraccount;



--5 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO bnkm.customeraccount --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT  
[CustomerAccountId]
,[CustomerAccountName]
,[CustomerAccountOpenedDate]
,[CustomerAccountClosedDate]
,[GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber]
,[CustomerId]
,[ResponsibilityCenterId]
,[SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId]
,[LedgerId]
,[LedgerAccountNumber]
,[IsoCurrencyCode]
,[CustomerAccountTypeId]
,[CustomerAccountApplicationNumber]
,[BranchId]
,[CustomerAccountShortName]
,[CustomerAccountNote]
,[Last6AccountNumber]
,[LastSixAccountNumber]
,[Remarks]
,[DeleteIndicator]
,[BaseAccountId]
,[InternalAccountId]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[CustomerAccountNotes]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[TaskRunId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[InsertDttm]
FROM bnkm.customeraccount_WITH_DUP_20230801 -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records
WHERE RN = 1;


--6 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
select CustomerAccountId,CustomerId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode,count(1)
from bnkm.customeraccount group by CustomerAccountId,CustomerId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode
having count(1) > 1



--7 COUNT
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.customeraccount_WITH_DUP_20230801
--5938032

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.customeraccount
--5938032
